[Intro]
[Am]
[Em]
[Am]I was

[Verse 1]
[Am]born on a Dublin street where the
[G]Royal drums the beat [Em]And the
[Am]loving English feet they went all
over us And
[C]every single night when me
[G]da' would came home [Em]tight He'd in-
[Am]vite the neighbors [Em]out with this
[Am]chorus Come out

[Chorus]
[Am]ye black and tans, come out and
[G]fight me like a man [Em]Show your wife
[Am]how you won medals down in
Flanders Tell her
[C]how the IRA made you run
[G]like hell away [Em]From the
[Am]green and lovely lanes [Em]of Killa-
[Am]shandra
Come

[Am]tell us how you slew them old
[G]Arabs two by two [Em]Like
[Am]Zulus they had spears, bows and ar-
rows How
[C]brave you faced one, owith your
[G]sixteenpounder [Em]gun And you
[Am]frightened them [Em]natives to their mar-
[Am]row Come out

[G]slandered great [Em]Parnell When you
[Am]fought them well and truly perse-
cuted Where are
[C]the sneers and jeers that you loud-
[G]ly let us hear [Em]When our
